description: Configure VSCode with IntelliJ IDEA keyboard shortcuts for editor migration. A developer switching from IntelliJ to VSCode needs familiar shortcuts. Two approaches: (1) Install 'IntelliJ IDEA Keybindings' extension from Extensions marketplace (Ctrl+Shift+X, search 'IntelliJ', install), OR (2) Manually configure keybindings.json via Command Palette > 'Preferences: Open Keyboard Shortcuts (JSON)' by adding entries like {"key": "ctrl+b", "command": "editor.action.revealDefinition"}. Required mappings: Ctrl+B -> editor.action.revealDefinition (Go to Definition), Ctrl+Alt+B -> editor.action.goToImplementation (Go to Implementation), Ctrl+N -> workbench.action.showAllSymbols (Go to Symbol), Ctrl+Shift+N -> workbench.action.quickOpen (Quick Open File), Ctrl+E -> workbench.action.openRecent (Recent Files). The keybindings.json file is located at /home/ga/.config/Code/User/keybindings.json and must be a valid JSON array. Installing the extension automatically configures all shortcuts.
